title: Recurring address context research
description: Recipient addresses with at least $5 net buying in the preceding 180 seconds. The context uses their earlier associations with first calls on other tokens, followed by fixed 60- or 180-second paper outcomes after a 10% proceeds haircut. Only fully completed outcomes are available. Histories use the past day or all prior data, at most 20 tokens per address, and three zero-return observations for shrinkage. Sizing uses history scores or scores relative to the prior token cohort. These are predictive contexts, not wallet PnL, ownership claims or Telegram identity links. Catalog seed: 20261023.

assumptions: Recipient proxies are chain-scoped; no ownership or member linkage.
Buy exposure nets quantities per recipient across the 180-second pre-call window; minimum $5.
Only the first eligible call per token supplies one baseline outcome.
Baseline waits five seconds, holds 60 or 180 seconds, applies a 10% proceeds haircut and clips returns to [-1,1].
Baseline outcome is available only after its complete admission horizon and realized exit.
Target-token outcomes are always excluded; only the latest 20 earlier outcomes per address are used.
Shrunk scores add three zero-return observations. These are signal outcomes, not wallet PnL.

status: Retrospective search on previously examined dates. Volume and gas/MEV are historical proxies, not measured executable quotes.
selection: Primary robust_5pct requires positive 5%/10% haircut training, at least 14 trades/10 contracts, <=5% candle drawdown, and positive 10%-cost replay after excluding the two best training tokens. Selection maximizes 10%-cost training return.
